scope: Frozen 267 compatibility-still-used descriptors in the supplied catalog; counts are baseline counts, not a claim that concurrent migration work remains unfinished.
method: Inspected each registered descriptor lowering and description, plus relevant flow-runtime state/capture/lifecycle delegates. Classification is manual per descriptor; private status is not evidence of atomicity. No gameplay source edits or runtime tests in this audit.

definitions.G: 通用读取但缺公开命名整合

categoryNotes.必须组合迁移: The wrapper contains derived policy, aggregation, record construction or field fallback that should move to generic graph composition. Its underlying controlled write, lifecycle, RNG or batch boundary may still be necessary; do not remove that boundary.
categoryNotes.合理权威宿主原语: A concrete controlled write, lifecycle, queued operation, identity/capture/time or generic execution-local state boundary. This does not endorse existing private naming or bypassing validation.
categoryNotes.通用读取但缺公开命名整合: Includes user-approved generic mathematical/spatial operations and range queries as well as basic reads. Exposing/unifying their contract is required; exploding distance into arithmetic is not required.
categoryNotes.协议适配必要: Compatibility with pending/choice/result forms. Can consolidate under typed public protocol APIs; this is not a claim every specialized name must remain.

limitations: This is a scope classification, not an implementation correctness verdict.
Several composition migrations were already assigned or in progress; baseline usage is intentionally retained for complete traceability.
Stateful composition requires controlled writes and exact raw-versus-lifecycle semantics; mutation of snapshot reads is not an acceptable replacement.
Source line numbers may move under concurrent edits.
A generic host boundary can have derived result fields that should be composed separately; reasons call out material examples.

items.label: 读取当前动态卡牌标识
items.classification: 通用读取但缺公开命名整合
items.reason: 当前cardId事实读取，统一context字段。

items.label: 读取当前卡牌触发类型
items.classification: 通用读取但缺公开命名整合
items.reason: 当前card触发type事实读取，统一context字段。

items.label: 结算生成卡牌伤害
items.reason: cardDamage保留冻结来源fallback及跳过before事件，是伤害host policy；需通用可命名策略而非图直接伪造事件。

items.label: 以指定归属提交类型伤害
items.reason: typed伤害+killer归因+inputPolicy权威入口，可统一伤害参数，保持事件拼写。

items.label: 构造卡牌行动结果
items.reason: success/message/keepInHand卡牌返回协议，统一result构造，不拆手牌生命周期。

items.label: 读取原始玩家标识文本
items.classification: 通用读取但缺公开命名整合
items.reason: 原始context.playerId文本读取，统一context字段但不可过早存在/大小写校验。

items.label: 不区分大小写查询玩家
items.reason: players按lowercase查找并返回受控错误文本；通用文本比较/find，保留null异常结果兼容。

items.label: 读取玩家显示名
items.reason: player.name或id的truthy fallback，player.field+选择。

items.label: 保留棋子数据快照
items.reason: 序列化快照剔除可执行rule.effect是安全/持久化边界；通用instance snapshot policy而非开放对象复制。

items.label: 从当前棋盘移除棋子
items.reason: 脱离现役集合生命周期及flowState清理策略，不能用列表filter替代。

items.label: 登记储存棋子
items.reason: owner规范化、scoped写与legacy-if-null存储策略；通用typed extension写并保留原存档路径。

items.label: 受控加入手牌
items.reason: 手卡写异常到success/error的旧结果协议；真实cards.add边界保留，可统一受控结果包装。

items.label: 按玩家标识文本加入手牌
items.reason: 原始playerId交给手牌生命周期并保留null失败；通用手牌接口可整合输入策略。

items.label: 验证棋子引用
items.classification: 通用读取但缺公开命名整合
items.reason: 不透明piece引用解析/存在校验，公开基础查询而非内容helper。

items.label: 验证玩家引用
items.classification: 通用读取但缺公开命名整合
items.reason: 不透明player引用解析/存在校验，公开基础查询。

items.label: 选择棋子目标
items.reason: 通用棋子选择pending/取消/候选校验协议，已认可选择原语。

items.label: 选择地格目标
items.reason: 通用地格选择pending/取消/候选校验协议，已认可选择原语。

items.label: 检查选择是否挂起
items.reason: 目标选择pending标志协议访问，适合统一typed选择结果接口。

items.label: 读取已选棋子
items.reason: 完成的选择对象到piece引用解码，需宿主引用验证。

items.label: 读取已选地格
items.reason: 完成的选择对象到cell解码，协议适配边界。

items.label: 造成伤害
items.reason: DamageBatch/queue伤害权威提交，事件/死亡/归因必须保持。

items.label: 排队治疗
items.reason: 获准healQueue追加请求，延迟治疗时机不能提前。

items.label: 权威位移
items.reason: 统一位置提交器，移动触发/合法性/回滚属宿主。

items.label: 事件伤害
items.classification: 通用读取但缺公开命名整合
items.reason: 事件damage字段读取，统一event/context field命名。

items.label: 返回消息
items.reason: success/message旧结果信封，可统一公开结果构造器。
